card.name: Linking words in monitoring and bleeding-risk text
card.fires_on: Small linking words (and, the, of, for, 's) in sentences about monitoring coagulation, platelet counts or bleeding risk, mostly with heparin, NSAIDs or anticoagulants.

modes.label: Monitoring phrases
modes.description: Small word right after a monitoring verb or noun, before the thing to be checked.
modes.example: Monitor platelet count<< and>> hematocrit in all patients receiving he

modes.label: Dose adjustment by lab results
modes.description: Possessive 's after patient, before coagulation test results.
modes.example: Adjust the dosage of Heparin Sodium Injection according to the patient<<’s>> coagulation test results.

modes.label: Risk increase wording
modes.description: The word the after increases, before the risk of serious events.
modes.example: increases<< the>> risk of serious gastrointestinal (GI) events

card.writes: It pushes down life-related words such as life and Life, with no clear positive output theme.
card.plain: It fires on small connecting words in sentences telling you to monitor blood tests or bleeding risk on anticoagulants.
